parcel_id_format.note: PARCELID embeds a DOUBLE SPACE: '090  07403', '125  00801'. Query as PARCELID LIKE '090  07403%'.

traps: PARCELID embeds DOUBLE SPACES — preserve them in the LIKE pattern; normalize only for comparison.
REPLACE() in a where clause returns 400. Fall back to an interleaved-wildcard LIKE '0%4%5%...' plus client-side normalized equality.
Direct REST access returns 401 anonymously — always go through proxy.ashx with the Referer header and a browser UA.
403 on POST means a missing Referer. 404 means it should have been a POST. A long geometry or a % in a GET returns 404, 400 or 414.
OWNER is ONE string carrying both owners ('FUGATE RONALD ALLEN & VIRGINIA M'). owner_2 is OPT for this county or Knox reports a permanent false gap. Split with octlib.split_owner_string().
FULL_MAIL_CITY_STATE_ZIP is a single combined field ('KNOXVILLE, TN 37931') — csz_mode combined, parse with octlib.csz_split().
The tax roll sits behind Search/Disclaimer.aspx on the first hit.
Tennessee_Property_Boundaries_Public_Use covers 86 of 95 counties — Knox is ABSENT from it.
TN is a disclosure state: PURCHASE_PRICE and SALE_DATE are real, unlike TX.
There is NO entity-pierce route for TN as of 2026-08-11 (OpenGovUS 500s, tnbear dead). Entity-owned Knox parcels emit UNEVALUATED — TN registry route down.
